items.title: Microsoft Teams: Events in Meet app in Teams in GCC
items.description: Users can now use the Teams Meet app to discover events across their organization, track what important events are upcoming, and plan and organize their own professional events. With this release, Meet app will be renamed to Events app.

items.title: Microsoft Copilot Studio: Conversational configuration of connectors in Copilot Studio
items.description: Configure the connectors your agent needs, with a simple in-chat sign-in instead of a full settings experience.

items.title: Planner: Track task progress with the Completion (%) field
items.description: The new Completion (%) column in Microsoft Planner provides a more precise view of task progress. Users can view and update completion as a percentage, helping teams communicate incremental progress and quickly understand how far work has advanced.

items.title: Microsoft Teams: Hide Organizer Name in Calendar View on Teams Panels and MTR-A.
items.description: Admins can now choose whether the organizer name will show up in the calendar view on Teams panels and MTR-Android.  In Pro Management Portal, admins can toggle the "Show Organizer Name" setting ON or OFF.  On the panel device, admins can toggle the "Show organizer names" setting ON or OFF. On the MTRA console device and All In One Display device, admins can toggle the "Show organizer names on calendar" setting ON or OFF.   Based on the selection, the organizer name will or will not be shown on

items.title: Microsoft Edge: Inline Switching for Workspaces
items.description: Workspaces Inline Switching manages multiple Workspaces in a single window. Selecting a Workspace swaps in its tabs, theme, and context, with an easy return to the default space.

items.title: Microsoft Teams: Pop out calls into a new browser window
items.description: Microsoft Teams browser app users will be able to pop out calls into a simplified call window that stays available while they navigate away from, hide, or minimize the tab or progressive web app (PWA) hosting the call. This helps users multitask and collaborate more easily during calls.

items.title: OneNote: Copilot Notebook in OneNote on Mac
items.description: Copilot Notebook, an AI-powered workspace for a project or topic built on reference materials, is coming to OneNote on Mac. Bring together your work context behind a project in one place.

items.title: Microsoft Teams: Granular channel notification controls
items.description: Microsoft Teams introduces flexible presets for channel notifications, allowing you to choose between All new messages, @mentions and replies, or Mute. You can further customize alerts for unfollowed threads, tags, and channel or team mentions, as well as control banner notifications for the channel. This added flexibility enables you to set notifications to match to your work style and reduce unnecessary distractions.

items.title: SharePoint: AI overview for SharePoint News posts in the SharePoint app for Teams
items.description: Users will be able access an AI generated audio summary of SharePoint News posts in the SharePoint app for Teams (Viva Connections).

items.title: Microsoft Teams: Facilitator detects and answers questions
items.description: Facilitator now automatically detects open questions raised during a Teams meeting and offers to help answer them using web search. When a participant asks a question (e.g., “What is an LLM?”) and no one answers, Facilitator posts a prompt offering to find an answer. Participants can select “Yes” to have the agent retrieve and share the information.

items.title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Intelligent Summaries in Copilot Dashboard
items.description: Use intelligent summaries in Copilot Dashboard to quickly surface what’s working and where targeted attention can accelerate Copilot adoption. Intelligent summaries highlight key adoption trends to focus on areas of success. Suggested prompts enable deeper exploration of underlying trends and drivers.

items.title: Microsoft Teams: Centralized notification settings for channels
items.description: Centralized notification settings streamline channel notification setup and management. Available in Teams settings, users have a single place to review and adjust notifications for all visible channels, instead of managing each individually.

items.title: Outlook: Print calendar events in new Outlook and Teams
items.description: Users will now have basic options for printing calendar events in #newoutlookforwindows and Teams calendar, including choosing whether to show all attendees or display a shortened list of up to 10 attendees via a checkbox.

items.title: Microsoft Purview: Compliance Manager-Purview Compliance Manager integration with Microsoft Foundry for automated mapping of AI regulations and evaluation of Compliance controls for Foundry Agents
items.description: This feature in Purview Compliance Manager shall enable customers to automatically access the compliance posture of Agents created in AI Foundry. Customers can map Agents being created in AI Foundry to compliance regulations and assessments in Purview Compliance Manager and get to know the compliance status and improvement actions to be innovative and compliant.

items.title: Microsoft Purview: Compliance Manager - AI Powered Regulatory Templates
items.description: This feature in Purview Compliance Manager shall enable customers to convert complex regulations from PDF documents to actionable controls and actions in multi cloud environment. Customers can use the converted regulatory templates to create assessments and identify compliance gaps, understand and implement controls to improve their compliance posture.

items.title: Viva Glint - Action Taking Report (Public Preview)
items.description: Introduction of a new report that provides transparency into platform activity by dashboard users. Metrics such as report views, Team Conversations completed, and Focus Areas created will be visible and filterable with this report.

items.title: Microsoft 365: The Next Generation of File & Folder Sharing
items.description: We're now introducing the third generation of the Microsoft 365 sharing experience designed to make collaboration simpler, smarter, and more secure by default. At the heart of this update is the new hero link, a single, powerful link that controls access to your files. Whether you copy a link, share via email, or send the URL from your browser, you now have a seamless and consistent way to share and stay in control of your files.

items.title: Microsoft Defender for Office 365: Full Submissions experience in GCC
items.description: This is item is no longer accurate and we are removing it from the roadmap, we apologize for any inconvenience.

items.title: Outlook: Automatically display auto-mapped calendars
items.description: Users will be able to automatically see their auto-mapped calendars when toggling from classic Outlook to the new. #newoutlookforwindows

items.title: Planner: Connected Plans
items.description: Connected Plans let teams link related plans together to organize work across projects and initiatives. Navigate between connected plans and make related work easier to find and manage.

items.title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Power BI reports as references in Copilot Notebooks
items.description: Copilot Notebooks now lets users add Power BI reports as references, bringing report data directly into their notebooks alongside files. Copilot uses this information to help generate more relevant summaries, presentations, and briefs grounded in the organization's data.

items.title: Microsoft Teams: Temporarily pause all notifications
items.description: Users can now temporarily pause all notifications to minimize interruptions and stay focused on important work, meetings, or other priorities, without changing their existing notification settings.

items.title: Microsoft Teams: Proximity join support for attendees in Teams events from Teams Rooms on Windows and Android
items.description: Attendees can take advantage of proximity join with Teams Rooms on Windows and/or Android for fast, effortless connection to nearby room systems during Teams events, such as town halls, webinars, and structured meetings.

items.title: Outlook: Drag and Drop
items.description: You can now reschedule events by dragging them to a new time slot in your calendar. This feature is available in day and multi day views.

items.title: Microsoft Teams: Open message links in new window
items.description: Teams now enables links within chat and channel messages to open in a new window, so you can compare information side by side without losing the context of your ongoing conversation. Access this capability through the More options menu or by using Ctrl/Cmd + click.

items.title: Microsoft Purview: Data Loss Prevention - Reduce policy sync status SLA on the Purview UI from 2 hours to 30 mins
items.description: Policy updates in Microsoft Purview now sync faster, reducing wait times from up to 2 hours to just 30 minutes, so your protections stay up to date and take effect more quickly across your organization.

items.title: Microsoft Purview: Data Lifecycle Management – Archive SharePoint files under retention
items.description: We are introducing file archiving support in SharePoint Online, utilizing this feature administrators can seamlessly include archiving actions within their existing data retention policies. This means that, in addition to keeping or deleting data, admins can now leverage Purview DLM to archive files according to organizational requirements, ensuring comprehensive governance across all stages of the content lifecycle in SharePoint Online. Retention based file archiving moves inactive content to l

items.title: Outlook: 1-year and 2-year options for email sync window (Offline settings)
items.description: In the new Outlook for Windows, users can choose to save 1 year or 2 years of email on their device for offline access. This expands the existing offline settings and allows users to access more email when they are not connected to the internet. The new options are available under Settings > General > Offline > Days of email to save, giving users greater flexibility based on their storage and offline needs."

items.title: Microsoft Teams: Security Detection Report in Teams Admin Center
items.description: A new Security Detection Report in the Teams admin center provides a centralized view of messaging security detections, including impersonation, malicious URLs, and weaponizable file types. Admins can review detection activity in one place and export detailed data to support investigation and response. This capability helps consolidate security signals for Teams messaging scenarios.

items.title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Newly created Declarative Agents now understand referenced scanned PDFs
items.description: Any newly created Declarative Agents can now reliably ground answers in scanned PDFs and image-based documents referenced from SharePoint, unlocking a major class of enterprise content that was previously hard to use in agent scenarios.

items.title: Microsoft Purview compliance portal: Tip Support in Outlook for Mac
items.description: DLP policy tips for Microsoft Outlook for Mac provide real-time notifications to users when their email contains sensitive information that violates organizational policies. Users can see policy tips directly in the mail tip UI and have the option to remove non-compliant recipients or override the policy if necessary. This feature ensures compliance by alerting users to potential data loss risks before sending emails.

items.title: Microsoft Purview Compliance Portal: DLP Policy Tip Support in Outlook Mobile
items.description: DLP policy tip support for Outlook Mobile enhances data loss prevention measures on mobile devices by providing real-time alerts to help users avoid accidentally sharing sensitive information, ensuring compliance with organizational policies.
